methods.what: Composition of two quadratics x^2-ax-b and x^2-a'x-b' into a quadratic whose middle coefficient is aa'+b+b' and whose constant term is bb', factored into linear factors
Recurrence scheme multiplying terms te^m + ue^n by e to obtain te^{m+1}+ue^{n+1}, with factor (e-b)/a
Cyclic system of equations linking p, q, r with coefficients a, b, c
